default.notes: Consular tourist visa required, applied for at an Argentine embassy or consulate.

groups.notes: Visa-free under Mercosur/associate arrangements — nationals can enter with just their national ID card (no passport needed) and stay up to 90 days; one 90-day extension (prórroga) can be requested from Migraciones.
Visa-free for tourism up to 90 days; one 90-day extension (prórroga) can be requested from Migraciones before the stay expires.
Visa-free for shorter stays under the bilateral arrangement — typically up to 30 days per entry; confirm the current allowance with an Argentine consulate before a longer trip.

Consular tourist visa required. Holders of a valid US or Schengen visa may qualify for the AVE electronic travel authorisation instead — confirm eligibility with the Argentine consulate or Migraciones before booking.

AR.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Argentine citizens.
